nodes.label: MapLibre over Leaflet Rationale
nodes.rationale: MapLibre chosen over Leaflet for vector tiles, better performance, and open-source licensing.

nodes.label: Stablecoin-on-Low-Fee-Chain Decision (USDT/USDC on TRON/Polygon)
nodes.rationale: Recommends a stablecoin on a low-fee chain to avoid subscription price swings from crypto volatility.
nodes.author: Project owner: Alexios

nodes.label: Per-Subscription Unique Derived Address (Anti-Interception Mechanism)
nodes.rationale: Deriving a unique receive address per place/billing-cycle is the core anti-interception mechanism — a leaked address is single-use.
nodes.author: Project owner: Alexios

nodes.label: Junior/Strong-Junior Time-Estimate Calibration
nodes.rationale: Sprint time estimates are deliberately wide-ranged, calibrated to a junior/strong-junior part-time solo developer rather than a generic mid-level '1-2 weeks' assumption; hitting unfamiliar walls is treated as the normal learning mechanism, not a failure.

nodes.label: Ports-Only-Where-Needed Layering Rule
nodes.rationale: A port (interface) only exists where Application needs something it can't do itself without touching an external system; in-memory Domain-to-Contract mapping needs no external system, so it stays as plain code inside PlacesQueryService rather than being hidden behind another interface.

nodes.label: Unique Derived Address Invariant
nodes.rationale: SUBSCRIPTIONS.derived_address and derivation_index are unique — no two places ever share a receive address.

nodes.label: Unique Tx Hash Invariant
nodes.rationale: PAYMENTS.tx_hash is unique — a single on-chain transaction can activate exactly one subscription.

nodes.label: Derived Place Visibility Invariant
nodes.rationale: Place visibility is a derived condition (moderation_status = Approved AND subscription_paid_until >= now() AND (NOT is_18plus OR viewer.allow_18plus_places)), not a stored flag, to avoid it drifting out of sync with a cached copy.

nodes.label: SignalR Redis Backplane Requirement
nodes.rationale: The Chat module's use of Redis as a SignalR backplane is only load-bearing once more than one API instance is running; Sprint 7 ships without it and Sprint 14/15 may add it.
